_comment: Seed catalog for the Phase 1 beta. Amounts, limits and dates change yearly: every row carries source_url and last_verified, and anything older than 90 days is flagged for re-verification. Rules of type agency_income_limit / agency_price_limit resolve to 'likely' until the agency's county tables are loaded into MatchContext.agency_limits.

programs.name: MHC Smart6
programs.benefit_text: 30-year fixed mortgage plus $6,000 down payment / closing cost assistance as an interest-free second lien, repaid on sale or refinance. Homebuyer education required.

rules.description: Property must be in Mississippi.
Must be your primary residence.
First-time buyer, or no home owned in the past 3 years.
Household income must be within MHC limits for the county.
Price must be within MHC's county purchase limit.

programs.name: MHC Easy8
programs.benefit_text: 30-year fixed mortgage plus $8,000 down payment / closing cost assistance. Homebuyer education required.

rules.description: Property must be in Mississippi.
Must be your primary residence.
First-time buyer, or no home owned in the past 3 years.
Household income must be within MHC limits for the county.
Price must be within MHC's county purchase limit.

programs.name: MHC MRB7
programs.benefit_text: Up to $7,000 down payment assistance as a deferred, no-interest loan with a mortgage revenue bond rate.

rules.description: Property must be in Mississippi.
Must be your primary residence.
First-time buyer, or no home owned in the past 3 years.
Household income must be within MHC limits for the county.
Price must be within MHC's county purchase limit.

programs.name: MHC Home4All
programs.benefit_text: Need-based assistance of up to $25,000. HUD-approved homebuyer counseling required before applying.

rules.description: Property must be in Mississippi.
Must be your primary residence.
Must be a first-time homebuyer.
Need-based: household income must be within program limits.

programs.name: MHC Housing Assistance for Teachers
programs.benefit_text: Grant of up to $6,000 toward down payment and closing costs for eligible educators.

rules.description: Property must be in Mississippi.
Must be your primary residence.
Must be an eligible educator.

programs.name: MHC DPA 14
programs.benefit_text: $7,000 forgivable 10-year second plus a $7,000 county grant.

rules.description: Coahoma, Tunica or Washington county only.
Must be your primary residence.
Acquisition limit $332,000.
Household income must be within MHC limits.

programs.name: USDA Section 502 Direct Loan
programs.benefit_text: Government-funded rural mortgage with payment assistance; 5.25% rate effective Sept 1, 2026. Apply through the local USDA RD office or a certified packager.

rules.description: Must be your primary residence.
Property must be in a USDA-eligible rural area.
Household income at or below the low-income limit (80% of area median).
Modest single-family home; not income-producing.

programs.name: USDA Section 502 Guaranteed Loan
programs.benefit_text: Up to 100% financing through approved private lenders, backed by USDA.

rules.description: Must be your primary residence.
Property must be in a USDA-eligible rural area.
Household income up to 115% of area median.

programs.name: FHA Loan
programs.benefit_text: Low down payment (3.5% with qualifying credit), FHA mortgage insurance applies. 1-4 unit properties allowed if you live in one unit.

rules.description: Must be your primary residence.
1-4 units only.

programs.name: FHA 203(k) Rehab Loan
programs.benefit_text: Rolls purchase and renovation costs into one FHA mortgage.

rules.description: Must be your primary residence.
1-4 units only.
Only useful when the property needs rehab.

programs.name: VA Home Loan
programs.benefit_text: No down payment and no private mortgage insurance for eligible service members and veterans.

rules.description: Must be your primary residence.
Must have VA eligibility (Certificate of Eligibility).
1-4 units only.

programs.name: Opportunity Zone 2.0
programs.benefit_text: Reinvest capital gains through a Qualified Opportunity Fund: deferral, a 10% basis step-up after 5 years, and tax-free appreciation after 10 years. New map runs Jan 1, 2027 - Dec 31, 2036.

rules.description: Property must be in a designated OZ 2.0 tract.
Requires capital gains to reinvest through a Qualified Opportunity Fund.
Investment property only; not for a personal residence.

programs.name: Rural Opportunity Zone (QROF)
programs.benefit_text: Qualified Rural Opportunity Fund holding 90%+ in rural OZ property: 30% basis step-up after 5 years (vs. 10%) and a lower substantial-improvement threshold.

rules.description: Property must be in a designated OZ 2.0 tract.
Tract must meet the OZ 2.0 rural definition.
Requires capital gains to reinvest through a Qualified Rural Opportunity Fund.
Investment property only; not for a personal residence.

programs.name: Opportunity Zone 1.0 (legacy)
programs.benefit_text: Original OZ tracts remain designated through Dec 31, 2028. Confirm current rules with a tax advisor before investing.

rules.description: Property must be in an original (2018) OZ tract.
Requires capital gains to reinvest through a Qualified Opportunity Fund.
Investment property only; not for a personal residence.

programs.name: LIHTC basis boost (QCT / DDA)
programs.benefit_text: Affordable multifamily in a Qualified Census Tract or Difficult Development Area can claim up to a 30% boost to eligible basis for Low-Income Housing Tax Credits.

rules.description: Tract must be a HUD QCT or DDA.
Multifamily development or land for one.
Investment or development strategy.
